'''Freeport Medical Services''' was a private [[Medcenter/Legends|medical facility]] in the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. It offered first aid, including [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] treatment, [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] limb replacement, and [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] treatment.<ref name="Game" />
